invariants.rationale: If 'clip' is false, the method always delegates to super.hit, otherwise it may return null early.
When 'clip' is true, if touch events are disabled, result must be null.

invariants.expression: !(clip && (x < 0 || x >= getWidth() || y < 0 || y >= getHeight())) || result == null
invariants.rationale: If 'clip' is true and the (x, y) coordinate is out of bounds, result must be null.

invariants.expression: result == null || !clip || (x >= 0 && x < getWidth() && y >= 0 && y < getHeight() && (!touchable || getTouchable() != Touchable.disabled))
invariants.rationale: If result is non-null, necessary geometric and touch conditions must hold.
If 'clip' is false, the only possible result is what super.hit returns.
